posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina kicks off shooting for 'Merry Christmas' with Vijay Sethupathi in Mumbai, while her Kay Beauty brand goes viral after a Bangalore Instagrammer's eyeliner review gets a heartfelt response from the actress.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit makes history as the first South Asian artist to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden on his AURA tour, while his Imtiaz Ali film with AR Rahman is set for a June 12 release.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia made waves at Cannes 2026 after her team overcame a power outage at the closing ceremony, while Bobby Deol praises her all-in action prep for YRF's spy thriller Alpha releasing July 10.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka presented at the 98th Academy Awards and confirms six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi alongside Mahesh Babu, set for April 2027.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's 'King' locks a December 24 Christmas release with a massive ₹350 crore budget — Pen Marudhar acquires theatrical rights for ₹250 crore as the star wraps filming in South Africa.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena opens up about a possible K3G sequel at ZEE Samvad 2026 and praises OTT as a 'welcoming change,' while a viral airport video shows a fellow passenger hilariously failing to recognize her.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is shooting the fantasy film Naagin and gearing up to lead and produce Pahadpangira, a feminist dark fantasy drama from the Tumbbad universe set to roll by mid-2026.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika speaks out against Bollywood's overwork culture as a new mom, filming action for SRK's King and Atlee's Raka with Allu Arjun — Sai Pallavi steps into Kalki 2 after Deepika's exit.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer faces a FWICE non-cooperation ban over his exit from Don 3 with ₹45 crore in damages demanded — he made his first masked public appearance at Mumbai Airport on May 26 amid the escalating controversy.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya dazzled at her 24th Cannes Film Festival with show-stopping couture and a feathered cape look, as Kangana Ranaut defended her against ageist trolling and daughter Aaradhya beamed with pride.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika wowed at the Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside Black Panther's Winston Duke, while her romantic track 'Tujhko' with Shahid Kapoor from Cocktail 2 (June 19) has fans swooning.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha makes a blazing comeback with the 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' trailer showcasing her fierce action avatar as a protective daughter-in-law — the film releases June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's mega collaboration with director Atlee, AA22xA6, is officially underway — the ₹600 crore VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle co-starring Deepika Padukone targets an August 2027 global release.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' crosses $393K in North American advance sales ahead of its June 4 IMAX release, while he went viral for accidentally calling cricketer Jasprit Bumrah a footballer.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' glimpse smashed 64 million YouTube views in 24 hours as director Prashanth Neel calls it his 'darkest and most risky creation' — the pan-India action epic targets a June 2027 release.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is on a promotional blitz for Ram Charan's 'Peddi' ahead of its June 4 release and joined cricket star Pat Cummins for a New Balance event — her film Homebound was India's official Oscar 2026 entry.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's 'Chand Mera Dil' crosses ₹15 crore as her fusion Bharatanatyam dance sparks heated online debate — father Chunky Panday defends the choreography as experimental, not traditional.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shuts down rumors about her film Toxic calling them 'absolute nonsense,' while gearing up to portray legendary actress Madhubala in a Sanjay Leela Bhansali biopic and embracing life with daughter Saraayah.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is set to begin directing Krrish 4 this summer for a 2027 release, while War 2 entered the ₹100 crore club but divided audiences — the ₹400 crore spy thriller sparked debate over its polarizing reception.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with Pooja Hegde is locked for a June release, but the recreated 'Chunnari Chunnari' drew sharp criticism from original singer Abhijeet Bhattacharya.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya wrapped her All Hearts Tour with a triumphant Mumbai finale and has announced 2026 US and UK concert dates, with a September show at Texas Trust CU Theatre already on sale.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman praises Hans Zimmer's work on the ₹4,000 crore Ramayana epic calling it 'one of India's greatest films,' while launching Rooh Records and partnering with Google Cloud on AI music innovation.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay celebrated his 51st birthday on May 25 as his final film 'Jana Nayagan' navigates legal and censorship delays — the political action thriller marks his cinematic farewell before entering politics.
